title: 꿈결의 경계
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A solo male vocalist performs with a soft, breathy delivery, transitioning into a spoken-word style. The arrangement features a delicate piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides sparse, arpeggiated accompaniment with light chorus and reverb. A subtle synth pad fills the mid-range frequency spectrum. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, set in the key of C Major. The production is intimate with a close-mic vocal technique and a wide stereo field for the instrumental elements.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[soft piano chords, clean electric guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
새벽 네 시다 옆자리가 비어 있다
이불의 온도가 달라진 건 어제가 아니다
[piano melody continues]
가로등이 꺼진다 방 안이 조금 더 어두워진다
냉장고 돌아가는 소리만 이 방의 유일한 숨소리다
[spoken-word delivery]
고요하다
